subject: general
question: Rebeca Grynspan, an economist was appointed as the Secretary General of which organization in June 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**UNCTAD.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Its full name is **United Nations Conference on Trade and Development.**
 
• It was established in **1964.**
 
• It is an **intergovernmental organization **intended **to promote **the **interests **of **developing states in world trade**.
 
• **UNCTAD **is **part of **the **United Nations Secretariat dealing **with **trade, investment**, and **development issues**.
 
• The** General Assembly **in the **sphere of trade **and **development**.
 
• **Its purpose **is the **promotion of trade **and **development, particularly in developing countries**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNISDR **stands for **United Nations International Strategy for Disaster Reduction.**
 
• **UNICEF**, in full originally called the **United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund**.
 
• **UNHRC **stands for **United Nations Human Rights Council.**
